New file: fixture [Binary file: contents are not displayed] New file: fixture.go // A hand-written fixture for preview transport; it is not model-generated code. package main import ( "encoding/json" "fmt" "math" "net/http" "os" "strconv" "time" ) func main() { mux := http.NewServeMux() mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { if r.URL.Path != "/" { http.NotFound(w, r) return } w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") fmt.Fprint(w, `Preview calculator

Preview calculator

A local fixture for verifying the preview build and serving path.

`) }) mux.HandleFunc("/sum", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { a, ea := strconv.ParseFloat(r.URL.Query().Get("a"), 64) b, eb := strconv.ParseFloat(r.URL.Query().Get("b"), 64) if ea != nil || eb != nil || math.IsInf(a, 0) || math.IsInf(b, 0) || math.IsNaN(a) || math.IsNaN(b) || math.Abs(a) > 1e6 || math.Abs(b) > 1e6 { http.Error(w, "Use finite amounts between -1000000 and 1000000", 400) return } w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json") _ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"sum": a + b, "greeting": os.Getenv("APP_GREETING"), "uid": os.Getuid(), "modelKeyPresent": os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY") != "" || os.Getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY") != ""}) }) server := &http.Server{Addr: ":3000", Handler: mux, ReadHeaderTimeout: 3 * time.Second, ReadTimeout: 5 * time.Second, WriteTimeout: 5 * time.Second, IdleTimeout: 10 * time.Second, MaxHeaderBytes: 8192} if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err) os.Exit(1) } }
